cap_original_validation.scope: All original walls, including excluded structures. Only the recorded selected-loop intersection in source split faces is allowed; other finite lines or overlapping areas are rejected.

cap_validation_summary.method: VTK finite candidate broad phase + finite plane-edge intersection + coplanar finite polygon overlap; actual shared cut boundary edges are allowed, overlapping area is not.

cut.local_barrier_method: Split only faces of selected loop; flood to artificial END. Other global plane loops and branches are retained untouched.
